title: PHASE2 — Achiri SIWA upgrade: wire Supabase auth provider for PROVISIONAL→STANDARD tier
rationale: Add POST /auth-webhook to Achiri server.ts that handles Supabase auth events. When provider is 'apple' (SIWA), upgrade user from free→tnd_basic tier via setUserTier. Verify optional ACHIRI_WEBHOOK_SECRET header.

tasks.description: Add POST /auth-webhook route to agents/achiri/server.ts. Parse Supabase auth event body, extract user.id and app_metadata.provider. If provider == 'apple', call setUserTier(userId, 'tnd_basic', 'siwa-upgrade'). Verify ACHIRI_WEBHOOK_SECRET header if env var is set. Return {ok, upgraded, tier}.
